name: Pentland Group plc
note: Pentland Group describes itself on its About Us page as 'a family business building and delivering positive brands in sports, outdoor and fashion'; Pentland Brands 'owns Speedo, Berghaus, Canterbury, Endura, ellesse, SeaVees, Red Or Dead and Mitre'. Pentland also holds 51.89% of JD Sports Fashion plc. Bailiwick Express (Feb 2023, reporting The Sunday Times) describes the group as 'owned by the billionaire Rubins family' and says it 'is chaired by Stephen Rubin OBE, whose father founded the firm in Liverpool in 1932'.
